race.title: Coral 'Daily Rewards Shaker' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: A typically interesting novice for the track with AQUA BLEU selected to come out on top. Warren Greatrex's 4-y-o boasts plenty of experience having scored 3 times in junior hurdles last season and with his Aintree reappearance second under his belt, he's interesting now tackling a longer trip. Well Achieved landed his only start in points and is respected, with recent course runner up Sappingirl and returning Trial by Jury others commanding plenty of respect. AQUA BLEU (IRE) WELL ACHIEVED (IRE) SAPPINGIRL (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Sappingirl (10/3), Terrano (5/1), Well Achieved (11/2), Aqua Bleu (6/1), Livio (6/1), Trial By Jury (8/1), Indulto Rouge (12/1), Spare The Voice (16/1), Wonder Flying (16/1), Ballypollard (20/1), Mister Coko (25/1), Asamahleroffact (50/1), Company Charge (66/1)
